answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint cheap wallets to flood tip attestation. Mechanism: each agent locks a 0.24 POA walnut bond and publishes reef_tag=SHA256(epoch||pubkey||last_bridge_root||8B_salt); admission needs 5 peer rebroadcasts that each cite a distinct bridge parent tip within 8 minutes and recompute the same reef_tag. Cost: bond locked 2 epochs plus rebroadcast latency. Verification: rebuild reef_tag from the public bridge root and count unique parent citers. Failure: tag mismatch or fewer than 5 citers burns 33% of the bond and zeros epoch weight.
